messages:
alex: Heads up — prod_gpu_tests is red on 3 runners (aws-gpu-1/2/gke-gpu-5). Failing stage: integration/gpu/inference. Link: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/12345

ci-bot: [build 12345] failed 3 tests: test_inference_batching, test_kv_cache, test_large_sequence. Top log snippet:
```
E2026-11-09 14:02:13.421 | GPU init failed: NVML: Driver/library version mismatch
E2026-11-09 14:02:13.422 | cudaSetDevice(0) -> CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN
E2026-11-09 14:02:15.123 | CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
```

maria: ok — sounds like host driver vs container CUDA toolkit mismatch. Can someone ssh into aws-gpu-1 and run `nvidia-smi` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`? Also what base image is the job using? (docker image: redwood/ci-gpu:latest?)

jonah: I saw similar last week — one of the nodes had driver 525 while container uses CUDA 11.x libs. Also saw `NVRM: Xid 31` on kernel from time to time. Quick repro steps I run locally:
```
docker run --gpus all -it --rm redwood/ci-gpu:latest bash
python tests/integration/run_gpu_test.py --batch-size 128 --seq-len 4096
nvcc --version
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
```

alex: thanks. I asked infra to dump host nvidia-smi — here are outputs from two nodes:
```
aws-gpu-1: nvidia-smi
Driver Version: 525.85.05  CUDA Version: 12.2
aws-gpu-2: nvidia-smi
Driver Version: 515.76.04  CUDA Version: 11.7
``` 
inside container `redwood/ci-gpu:latest` reports CUDA 11.8 libs.

maria: that's the mismatch. Some tests then fallback and OOM because cublas/cuda libs behave differently. We should either pin the container CUDA to match driver or ensure we use a container with forward-compatible drivers. For short term: can we re-run failing jobs on aws-gpu-2 only? It has 11.7 which is closer to 11.8.

jonah: also adding a small preflight check in CI would save time: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv` and parse compatibility with container's cuda version. If mismatch, skip GPU tests with a clear message.

sam: I'll take the bisect/rerun. Plan: 1) re-run failing job on aws-gpu-2, 2) run `git bisect` between `main~30`..`main` with the failing test suite, 3) add CI preflight step. Starting with rerun now.

infra-bot: queued re-run for build 12345 on aws-gpu-2

ci-bot: re-run started by infra-bot — build 12346

alex: thanks sam. If re-run green, we'll open a follow-up to add the preflight; if still failing on aws-gpu-2 then we bisect. Also add note to the release checklist about ensuring image CUDA matches host driver matrix.

sam: got it. I'll ping here with bisect progress. Assigning issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/781 (driver-compatibility-guard)

jonah: also can we lower default batch-size in that test to reduce OOM noise while we triage? quick PR would help.

alex: agreed — @maria can you open a tiny PR to reduce batch from 128 -> 32 and mark it flaky-exempt? :thumbsup:

maria: on it, will open in 10m. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build 12346 started; will update on completion.
